snippets.snippet_text: "While Lemon Squeezy caters to solo creators and indie hackers, Polar is built for developers who need robust APIs, advanced features, and the ability to scale to enterprise-level requirements." and "At $50,000 monthly revenue, Polar saves you $500/month.
